column1: # OpenDNA antibody dataset: the OAS data units this dataset is built from.
# Chosen by a stated rule (one unit per donor, spread across studies, within a size
# band), not by taste. OAS publishes no stable URL for its unit index, so this file is
# the catalogue and a change to it belongs in a reviewed diff.
# purpose says which cohort a unit feeds. There is no train/test split: all mouse
# donors share identical rearrangements and form one indivisible group, so the dataset
# is four evaluation cohorts. The antibody module documents the measurement.
# donor is the key the unit was selected under, and the build checks it against the
# unit's own metadata. It is also what keeps this catalogue disjoint from
# oas_human_donors.tsv, which the humanness table is built from.
# sha256 "-" means the unit has been chosen but not yet downloaded and hashed. The
